protocol.prefix: Actual empty reach, manual release,140 frozen grasp actions; all failures count without retry
protocol.pairing: Same seed/placement for both directions; exact physical/controller/camera/RNG/model signature required
protocol.action_audit: Counterfactual copy changes only active G entries; real preparation history kept, alternate action never applied
protocol.credit: Actor sensitivity is not physical controllability; world-Z progress and off-axis motion from actual dynamics, no acceptance

summary.limits: Goal-action sensitivity does not prove correct direction, local reachability or a causal learning failure mechanism

interpretation: Goal changes affect actions, but mean correct-axis progress is small and off-axis motion remains. This does not establish local reachability, reward/exploration causality or a deployable controller.

paired_physical_response.interpretation: Matched closed-loop goal changes affect yaw in the correct direction on all7 development pairs, but with about0.10 response gain; this does not establish global reachability or a safe gain multiplier.
